_README: The single source of truth for pbandjsounds.com. Every page, the sitemap, the JSON-LD and /llms.txt read this file through lib/content.ts. How to add an event or media: CONTENT.md. Dates are ISO 8601: "2026-02" (month), "2026-02-14" (day), or "2026-02-14T22:00-05:00" (with doors time, which turns on the countdown). Event order is computed from dates, so position in this list doesn't matter. Media paths are under public/.

collective.blurb: PB&J Sounds is an East Coast house collective and label, founded in 2024 by Peter Jacob, Monty and Humphreys. The sound is underground UK, minimal and deep house. The collective curates, plays and lights its own nights, on a rig Humphreys built in-house. Its members have supported Martin Ikin, Biscits and Öwnboss, and PB&J has played Echostage.

founders.name: Peter Gomes
bio: Peter Jacob is a DJ and producer from Silver Spring, Maryland, and the PB&J co-founder behind artist relations and event curation. Eight years of piano lessons gave him his musical grounding; parties and events gave him the rest.

In the studio he chases "the 90s inspired tech house sound coming out of Europe and the UK," and releases his edits as free downloads on SoundCloud. Behind the decks he "likes to have a little bit of everything under [his] belt": Latin house, deep house, minimal and tech house.
founders.quote: No matter what I play or make, the goal is always to get people grooving and moving.
highlights: LoveGame (Peter Jacob Edit) reached No. 7 on Hypeddit's Top 100 Downloads: Tech House chart (October 12, 2026).

founders.name: Brody Montag
bio: Monty (Brody Montag) is a house and indie-dance DJ and producer from New Jersey, based in the DMV. He has played Somewhere Nowhere, Zebbie's Garden and Soundcheck, and supported artists including Martin Ikin, Biscits and Öwnboss. His sets run on warm basslines and crisp percussion, built for forward motion without losing subtlety.

He came up on Monstercat and OWSLA, played piano, oboe, viola and drums, and started producing in GarageBand at ten, with Algoriddim's djay alongside. Around twelve he moved to FL Studio and Rekordbox and made hip-hop beats for local artists on commission. At the University of Maryland he returned to DJing and to crate-digging: deep house, minimal and disco-leaning cuts.
Research in signal processing and machine learning shapes how he produces and plays. As PB&J's co-founder and lead organizer, he runs planning and strategy.
founders.quote: Passionate about the intersection of technology and music

founders.name: Jack Humphreys
bio: Humphreys (Jack Humphreys) is PB&J's DJ and visual coordinator: he designs the lighting and staging for the collective's nights. He started in event production in 2021, throwing parties for friends, and co-founded PB&J with Peter and Brody in 2024 to bring dance music and lighting design together.

He runs a mobile rig he built himself: truss, moving heads, strobes and haze, driven from an Onyx console. It lights PB&J's events and productions for other promoters, including Offstage and Dubstep After Dark.
founders.quote: Blending visual creativity with technical expertise to turn any space into an electric atmosphere for dance music
gear: ProX truss system (10 ft and 15 ft, adjustable height)
